Launch a wave of agents to implement features

Select features from the tasks file, create worktrees, and spawn agents. Supports multiple selection strategies.

Aliases: `l`

```sh
woco launch [flags]
```

Modifies project state. Supports `--dry-run`.

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--top-priority` |  | number |  | Select top N features by priority |
| `--quickest-wins` |  | number |  | Select N features with lowest effort |
| `--priority` |  | string |  | Filter by priority level. Values: `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `wishlist`. |
| `--difficulty` |  | string |  | Filter by difficulty level. Values: `trivial`, `easy`, `medium`, `hard`, `very_hard`. |
| `--tasks` |  | string |  | Select specific tasks by comma-separated IDs |
| `--all-ready` |  | boolean | `false` | Select all features whose dependencies are met |
| `--max-concurrent` |  | number |  | Max agents running in parallel |
| `--model` | `-m` | string |  | Model to use (e.g., anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514) |
| `--dry-run` |  | boolean | `false` | Show what would be launched without launching |
| `--base-branch` |  | string |  | Base branch (default: from config) |
| `--max-retries` |  | number |  | Max retries per agent |
| `--tui` |  | boolean |  | TUI dashboard (default on); pass --no-tui for plain console output |
| `--ui` |  | boolean |  | Ink UI (default on); pass --no-ui for pure CLI mode |
| `--auto-push` |  | boolean | `false` | Push base branch to remote after all merges |
| `--agent` |  | string |  | Use a specific local agent definition for all tasks |
| `--quest` |  | string |  | Quest ID to scope this launch to |
| `--browser` |  | boolean | `false` | Enable browser-based verification for launched agents |
| `--dev` |  | boolean | `false` | Enable developer mode (hidden TUI features like fake task seeding) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
